description: Propose a validated unified diff for one finding, then apply exactly that diff after a human reviewed it. mode=propose (the default) writes no source files; it stores a local proposal and returns fixId, diffSha256 and expiresAt. mode=apply requires those values, verifies every target file is unchanged and applies the stored diff to the working tree; it never commits. apply=true is a deprecated alias for mode=apply and is unbound only when the server enables the unsafe escape hatch.

apply.description: Deprecated: true means mode=apply and still needs fixId and diffSha256. Defaults to false.

diffSha256.description: SHA-256 of the proposed diff. Required for mode=apply.

findingId.description: Finding ID (VGL-...), fingerprint (fp_...) or a unique prefix.

fixId.description: Proposal ID returned by mode=propose. Required for mode=apply.

line.description: Line number within path. Omit to match the only finding on that path.

mode.description: propose returns a diff and a fixId without writing; apply applies a reviewed proposal.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the finding; use with line instead of findingId.

scanId.description: Scan to look in. Defaults to the most recent scan.

name: vigil_fix
title: Propose or apply a fix for a Vigil finding
